derivation: Structural module split of the upstream index.mjs; protocol, plugin-owned OAuth refresh/concurrency, public exports and account limit classification retained. Intentional local-source-only security change: Kiro CLI/IDE references are read-only and client-managed, with no plugin refresh, CLI execution or credential writeback.

localSourceContract.reads: Only the explicitly associated client's credential is reread. Legacy source kiro must be associated again with an explicit source; no fallback to another source or copied auth token. CLI SQLite is always opened read-only.
localSourceContract.identityBinding: The pure reference contains source, actual management email/accountId and localIdentity.email. Email comes from Get-Usage-Limits for the freshly read token and is compared case-insensitively on every local load, ensure, usage, model fetch and forward. Bare historical email bindings may be checked; generic names, loginProvider/channel uid, token hashes and host account IDs are never identities.
localSourceContract.ownership: Only the original client refreshes and syncs these credentials. The plugin never redeems their refresh tokens, runs a refresh CLI, writes credential databases/cache files, or consults its held/after credential mirrors for a local reference. References store no token, refresh, expiry, registration or profile credential copies.
localSourceContract.unavailableExpiredOrRefused: Missing or changed identity and forced automatic rotation fail closed with code local_precondition; unavailable/expired/refused credentials use status 401 and code expired. Failed verification is not ignored, models do not fall back after local failure, and chat uses exactly the management-verified token without self-refresh or retry. Existing usage-limit/error classification remains.
localSourceContract.ensure: auth.ensure(authSnapshot, info, {getAuth, force, signal}) verifies the actual local identity and, when supplied, the live reference before and after verification, then returns the same complete pure reference. It never uses info/scope host account IDs. Nonlocal returns undefined and is not marked validated by this local-only hook.
localSourceContract.independentOAuth: Plugin-initiated OAuth refresh protocols, shared refresh lock, replacement-token cache and auth store/CAS boundary are unchanged. The existing oauth:own held/cache account partition concern is reported separately, not repaired in this local-only revision.

hostAdaptation.scope: Per-authorization browser OAuth listener lifetime and local sign-in result only; public browserSignIn/ownSignIn exports, upstream commit, MIT notice, PKCE/state, redirect/protocol fields and independent OAuth refresh remain unchanged.
hostAdaptation.managerHooks: authorize(inputs, scope) accepts the non-enumerable inputs.signal and scope.signal; scope.login.registerCleanup(cancel) is registered before any timer/server/listen await. HTTP request callbacks use scope.login.bind to restore the detached flow's auth/proxy scope and catch stale-flow binding rejection. Authorization exposes async cancel returning a shutdown-certifying boolean; no loginCleanup adapter or global dispose is required.
hostAdaptation.cleanup: Each round owns its candidate listeners, accepted sockets and ten-minute timer. Cancellation/timeout settles failed, aborts this round and clears its timer immediately; pending listen awaits are settled too. Cleanup awaits actual server close and socket close, checks listening/address/socket count, is idempotent and reports false rather than certifying an unclosed resource. Bun 1.3.14 force-closes native connections before close because close clears its native-server reference; Node closes first to invalidate pending numeric-host listens. Success reaches the callback only after listener shutdown, with no delayed-close timer.
hostAdaptation.callbackSafety: Explicit 127.0.0.1 listeners; exact localhost/127.0.0.1 Host and request-origin validation, bounded GET callback paths/headers/responses, no request body or upgrade/CONNECT sockets. Kiro/AWS state is validated before error settlement, duplicate in-flight callbacks cannot exchange twice, asynchronous transitions recheck cancellation. Exchanges use host-patched fetch with the round signal and original deadline; response bodies are bounded and raw upstream/error/query credentials are never returned to UI or logged.
hostAdaptation.ownSignIn: The selected CLI/IDE credentials are live-verified with localWhoIs(c,{signal}). Missing/unverifiable/generic identity fails; success contains only type, provider, explicit source, actual email/accountId and lower-case localIdentity.email. No access, refresh, expires, profile or registration snapshot is returned.
hostAdaptation.validation: Syntax check only; no tests, real OAuth/API calls, CLI execution, credential writes, documentation, version changes or commit/push/tag operations. Devin/Zed changes are outside this revision.
